newsitem.title: UK: NIE, Vertex in services joint venture.
newsitem.headline: NIE, Vertex in services joint venture.

text.p: Northern Ireland Electricity Plc said on Tuesday it had agreed to form a new joint venture company with Vertex Data Sciences Ltd, a unit of Britain's United Utilities Plc.
NIE said the new company, to be 51 percent owned by Vertex, would provide business services in the outsourcing market, which it said was worth potentially 500 million stg annually.
The new company, Vertex (Ireland), will operate from both Belfast and Dublin and is expected to start business in July.
NIE is the purchaser, distributor and supplier of electricity to over 600,000 customers throughout Northern Ireland.
Initially, Vertex (Ireland) will contract to provide a range of business services to NIE, including information systems, training centre services and meter reading, among others.
That business should provide Vertex (Ireland) with initial annual turnover of over 25 million stg. Around 400 NIE workers are expected to transfer to the new joint venture, NIE said.
